headline: Sensex zooms up to 2,000 points as Nifty crosses 25,900 driven by strong foreign fund inflows

marketStatus.message: Market is open for trading today.

why: Strong foreign institutional investor (FII) buying and foreign fund inflows
Lower crude oil prices supporting economic and market sentiment
Rally led by private banking and FMCG sectors alongside reverse AI trade
Rupee surging to an 8-month high boosting market confidence
whatHappening: Sensex intraday gains reached up to 2,000 points while holding over 1,000-point gains
Nifty 50 reclaimed 25,800 and touched intraday highs of 25,951
Indian equity markets rallied 1.8%, helping recoup nearly all losses recorded in 2026
Auto PLI scheme disbursed ₹4,385 crore in the first eight months of FY27
summary:
Indian benchmark stock indices experienced a massive rally on 25 November 2026, with Sensex zooming up to 2,000 points and Nifty crossing 25,900.
The surge was primarily driven by strong foreign fund inflows, low crude oil prices, and buying in FMCG and private bank stocks.
With a gain of 1.8% during the day, Indian equities have recouped nearly all of their losses for 2026.
